modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chatblock: Chat keyword filter: messages from others containing keywords won't be displayed on your client. Your own messages are unaffected. Also covers system messages (server announcements, etc.); offline server echo exemption via text matching (configurable).
chatblocker.command.keyword_added_unsave: §eKeyword added: %s, but saving failed (it will be lost after restart)
chatblocker.command.keyword_removed_unsa: §eKeyword removed: %s, but saving failed (it will be lost after restart)
chatblocker.command.reload_fail: §cConfiguration file missing or corrupted, kept current settings
chatblocker.command.save_failed: §cSaving the configuration failed; changes may be lost after restart
chatblocker.config.title: ChatBlocker Settings
chatblocker.config.enabled.desc: When disabled, no messages are filtered. Takes effect after saving; cancelling discards changes.
chatblocker.config.exempt_own_echo.desc: For offline server chats without sender info, exempts your own message echo by text matching: short texts must match at the end, longer texts may appear anywhere.
chatblocker.config.keywords.desc: Messages from others containing any keyword will not be displayed (case-insensitive).
